title: POST /v1/tasks request
description: events = [task.meta, prompt] (03-api.md section 4.6), or [task.meta] alone for a captured task without an agent (ADR-100 section 5); placement: the chosen device and VM (ADR-075 section 6); urgency, assignee_id, topic_id: the ticket fields (ADR-100 section 1)

github_identity.description: the GitHub identity of the task (ADR-078 section 3); optional

analysis.description: a task of the kind analysis (ADR-097 section 1): its scope and period (default the last 7 days); needs the prompt

assignee_id.description: the responsible user: an active member of the organization, a person or an agent account (ADR-100 section 1)

topic_id.description: the topic: the ref of a topic.profile event of the organization (ADR-100 section 3)
